Subject: Crate consolidation request + attached BOL

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick one — our freight team at Brightline picked up the exhibit crates this morning but the Bill of Lading they sent (BOL_4592.pdf attached) lists 4 pallets for "Suite A" while our advance warehouse manifest shows the pallets split across "Suite A" and "Suite B" and addresses differ. Warehouse cutoff for the advance location is Friday 08/22 EOD. Can you confirm which address Redwood wants the consolidated shipment to be delivered to and whether we should request Brightline reissue a consolidated BOL to avoid customs reclassification?

Attached: BOL_4592.pdf (pdf)

Alex — thanks for the heads-up. Redwood needs the full shipment consolidated to the advance warehouse at: 450 Event Park Dr, Loading Dock 3 (NorthStar Summit build). Please reissue a single BOL showing Redwood Inference as consignee with 4 pallets under one reference. Customs must see a single consignee to avoid separate duty triggers.

Brightline — please confirm ETA to the advance warehouse and if you can update the BOL by EOD today so we can forward to the customs broker. If reissue isn't possible, we need clear parcel-level manifests and photos for customs to accept the split.

Karthik Iyer

Karthik / Alex — thanks. We pulled the load and unfortunately the pickup was split at origin because two facility manifests were used by the shipper. We can reissue a consolidated BOL, but our paperwork team needs a signed reconsent from the shipper (Gotham) approving the consolidation and a corrected consignee address. That paperwork usually takes 4–6 business hours once we get consent. ETA to advance warehouse currently 08/21 11:30 CT (tracking: https://tracking.brightlinefreight.com/track/BL-4592).

I've attached photos from the pickup and the current manifest (manifest_photos.zip). If customs needs immediate clarification we can provide a carrier letter outlining the pickup split and chain of custody.

Ops Team
Brightline Freight
ops@brightlinefreight.com

From: Horizon Customs Broker <customs@horizonbroker.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Brightline Freight <ops@brightlinefreight.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NorthStar Summit - BOL clarification for customs

Hi all — we reviewed the BOL and current manifests. Customs will accept consolidation if: (1) the carrier issues a single consolidated BOL showing Redwood Inference as the consignee and (2) the shipper provides a short written reconsent indicating the intention to consolidate shipments originating from multiple origin manifests. Without that, shipments are treated as separate entries which could trigger additional duties and delay release at the advance warehouse.

If you can get the consolidated BOL and shipper consent by 08/19 20:00 PT we can flag the entry for expedited processing; otherwise expect 24–48 hour hold while we file amendments.

Regards,
Priya Sharma
Brokerage Manager
Horizon Customs Broker
customs@horizonbroker.com

Attachment: Customs_RESPONSE_0819.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — will update with the BOL and final ETA later today.
